[[File:Sauvax.jpg|right|thumb|A Sauvax holding a gruush.]]
A '''gruush''' was a pointed non-dedicated tool favored by the [[Sauvax]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Leritor/Legends|Leritor]].<ref name="u">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref><ref name="g">{{GamerCite|10|Standoff on Leritor}}</ref>

The gruush was a long spear attached to a pointed [[Bone/Legends|bone]] or scrap of metal. One of the ends of the gruush ended in a spiked point plus a curved hook.<ref name="u" /><ref name="g" />

The gruush was intended to be used for fishing, particularly in the continental shelves of Leritor.<ref name="u" /> The Sauvax also used gruushes to grow slime and algae, again in the shelves.<ref name="g" /> It was also commercially sold for 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="u" />

Although the Sauvax were not a warlike people,<ref name="g" /> the gruush could be used as a weapon, both by piercing and by throwing it. In that case, the damage caused by a gruush could compare to any traditional spear,<ref name="u" /> or to the more dangerous point of the two-bladed [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaderffii]] of the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="t">Comparing the damage statistics in the RPG, with the gruush being detailed in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' and the gaderfii in ''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]'', ''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]'' and ''[[Galaxy's Most Wanted: Scourge of the Desert]]''</ref> A [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] known as [[Professor/Legends|Profex]] [[Rynalla]] killed several settlers on Leritor, eventually leaving behind several gruushes so that the Sauvax, the only known users of weapon, would be blamed for the attack.<ref name="g" />
